{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows strong bearish signals (e.g., sentiment < 0.00).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if last 5-7 days show upward momentum, apply a 10-15% upward bias correction.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly below 30-day moving average, adjust upward by 5-10% to align with historical mean.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility during low-sentiment periods — suppress sharp upward/downward moves when sentiment is flat or neutral.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is higher than forecast by >5% over 3-5 days, apply a 2-3 day lag correction by increasing forecast by 1-2% per day until convergence.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending upward, apply a 5-10% upward bias to forecast to capture momentum.",
    "If forecast consistently underestimates true outcome in high-sentiment periods, increase forecast by 5-10% for the next 3-5 days to account for sentiment-driven overreaction."
  ]
}
